reason: P06-06 adds a synthetic-only one-shot monitor and local fake-receiver acceptance. New code reads pinned owned Docker containers, fixed loopback app/DB/TLS endpoints, actual host/DB/tmpfs usage, and verified encrypted backup receipts. It records bounded allowlisted event IDs before delivery, sends only to a fixed loopback /events receiver with no redirects/proxy, deduplicates unchanged states and recovery transitions, and retains pending events through lost acknowledgments, process restart, backoff and three-attempt blocking. Existing initializer, backup/restore, seed, MFA and API test helpers are reused unchanged. New actual PostgreSQL/Docker acceptance covers app/DB stoppage with healthy independent operator/B, real 64MiB tmpfs ENOSPC, backup failure and age/integrity, TLS and disk threshold injection, then source/config/original packages and keys unavailable during clean restore from staged local copies. RPO sentinel and local recovery components are measured; no physical host/offsite guarantee. No application, identity, migration, dependency or frontend source changes, so no unrelated C# or web test groups are selected. Compose acceptance installs the pinned .NET SDK for existing EF tooling and builds the scoped operator image; existing CI scope regressions remain mandatory. Existing initializer uses EF --no-build, so the new compose-only acceptance explicitly restores/builds the host Server project before migration-script generation; no C# code or test contract changes.
